parameters.content:
## Reel factory: find references
**/refs** in the Telegram bot (or the weekly scan of **dtj_reel_watchlist**, Mondays 9:00) asks Apify for reference videos: Instagram reels of a handle or hashtag, Pinterest videos for a search, Meta Ad Library video ads (India, active, longest running first). New ones go to **dtj_reel_library** and to Telegram with Keep / Skip; a tap sets keep = yes / no (every 15 minutes).

Apify token: only in the credential **DTJ Apify** (Header Auth, name `Authorization`, value `Bearer <token>`). Costs: at most `limit` results per source (10 max) and a charge cap per call. Source in git: `n8n/reel-factory/`.
